geo_bias_note: lat/lon excluded from model — rainfall-only feature set selected.

excluded_features.name: latitude
excluded_features.reason: GEOGRAPHIC PRIOR: In the ablation experiment lat/lon combined importance was ≥0.25 ROC-AUC drop when removed, indicating geographic memorization. Rainfall-only model selected to ensure predictions reflect physical susceptibility rather than GSI survey coverage patterns.

excluded_features.name: longitude
excluded_features.reason: GEOGRAPHIC PRIOR: Same as latitude. See ablation analysis.

excluded_features.name: distance_to_nearest_slide_km
excluded_features.reason: TARGET LEAKAGE: Positive points have distance=0 to themselves in the GSI inventory; negatives have distance≥exclusion_km by construction. The model would learn to discriminate proximity-to-label-source rather than environmental susceptibility.

excluded_features.name: slide_count_within_5km
excluded_features.reason: TARGET LEAKAGE: Positive points are GSI inventory members and thus always have high local density. Negatives are excluded by buffer. The feature trivially separates labels.

excluded_features.name: slide_count_within_10km
excluded_features.reason: TARGET LEAKAGE: Same spatial autocorrelation leakage as 5km density.

excluded_features.name: slide_count_within_25km
excluded_features.reason: TARGET LEAKAGE: Same spatial autocorrelation leakage as 5km/10km density.

excluded_features.name: elevation_m
excluded_features.reason: DATA UNAVAILABLE: No DEM raster present in project. Will be added in future phase after real DEM ingestion.

excluded_features.name: slope_degrees
excluded_features.reason: DATA UNAVAILABLE: Requires DEM. Not fabricated.

excluded_features.name: aspect_degrees
excluded_features.reason: DATA UNAVAILABLE: Requires DEM. Not fabricated.
